method.compression: gzip.compress(data, compresslevel=9, mtime=0) per file, then sum; estimate, not measured HTTP, app-store or installer download
method.engine_partition: Read actual compiled host imports, manually supply runtime auxiliary roots from source, recursively follow quoted local js/mjs/wasm filenames. Conservative all-feature dependency closure, including lazy optional imports. Shared files counted once in partition; not an initial-load network trace.
method.font_scope: Standalone .ttf/.otf/.woff/.woff2 in build/web only; excludes font data embedded inside WASM or documents
method.license_scope: Both original notices and generated aggregate are currently bundled. Identical-byte duplicates are identified, not removed. Aggregate overlap is not treated as byte-identical file duplication.
method.native_size_limit: Raw asset bytes approximate native resource contribution only. Actual native compressed packages were not built or measured.

scope: Existing 2026-11-13 JavaScript web release assets and matching tracked selected runtime; no rebuild
